cvText.title: CV / Resume Text
cvText.description: Paste your CV or resume text here. The agent will extract your skills, experience, and job titles to find matching jobs.

searchKeywords.title: Job Search Keywords (optional)
searchKeywords.description: Additional keywords to search for on Glassdoor (e.g., 'Python developer', 'Data scientist'). If empty, keywords are extracted from your CV.

location.title: Job Location
location.description: Location to search jobs in (e.g., 'New York, NY', 'London', 'Remote'). Leave empty for worldwide.

maxJobs.title: Maximum Number of Jobs
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of job listings to scrape and rate.

withinLastMonth.title: Filter Jobs Within Last Month
withinLastMonth.description: When enabled, only shows jobs posted within the last 30 days. If fewer than 5 jobs are found within that period, shows all available jobs.

minMatchScore.title: Minimum Match Score (0-10)
minMatchScore.description: Only include jobs with a match score at or above this value.
